    base_accent := channel_styles.progress.palette.accent
    channel_styles.progress.palette.invalid = c.palette.invalid
    for i in 0:4 {
        channel_styles.progress.palette.accent = base_accent

        // The parent already validated these styles. Apply the unchanged
